test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Z is an immediate neighbour of both U and V. Z is second to the left of X. S is an immediate neighbour of both U and T. U sits third to the left of X. W is an immediate neighbour of T. Y sits second to the right of V. Who sits third to the left of T?
solution:
Given: Eight persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) Z is second to the left of X.

2) U sits third to the left of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24571674ff4bf2ec46503ad3a5e0b18e5e6f11168f20a9ea847a298fe3bb600e.png] 

3) S is an immediate neighbour of both U and T. 

4) Z is an immediate neighbour of both U and V. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb80d1a001c5e283e2fc11cb771e716322a6b3f758eb989c438b733eda4f9aa2.png] 

5) W is an immediate neighbour of T. 

6) Y sits second to the right of V. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4eb3961effa88baaee38da4f2d7f1add6ecad8663c8f1e7d692c6903cfd27a9.png] 

So, 'X' sits third to the left of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
